reviewer: Codex: authored five-language material and actual isolated CLI output review
review_scope: Read the complete five-language lesson and distinct fictional demonstration/practice inputs. Inspected actual saved-register outputs from ten subprocess CLI exercises: capture, rescheduling, fresh-process reads, saved meeting summaries/actions and completion. Tests preserve the ordinary and demonstration registers. Busy periods and the tutorial-local-only calendar ID are explicitly fictional; no connector receipt, live calendar write, model interpretation, native voice session, paired-chat learner participation or measured comprehension/timing is attested. Native paired teaching uses the existing Codex course runtime; the ordinary organizer retains its Cowork path. Six stages total 390 seconds of planned explanation, with execution and questions additional.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: Read the complete it outline: saving a commitment, changing its time, retrieving it and retaining meeting actions. The scope begins with the separate local register and makes the optional live-calendar extension conditional on account selection, authorization and actual read-back.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read both case-it.json inputs. Studio Riva/Paola/Sara on 10 November is distinct from Studio Selva/Luca/Elena on 12 November. The requests and meeting facts are localized, explicitly fictional and contain no precomputed identifiers or successful connector receipts. The busy-period label is localized and identifies an example, not live availability.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The actual demo output reopens Incontro con Paola at 2026-11-10T14:00:00+01:00 with revision 2. Saved meeting summary retains the input notes and its follow-up task has the supplied owner, date and source. Separate subprocess reads verify persistence, and local storage never becomes a claimed Google Calendar write. Model reasoning about priorities and meeting semantics remains for the actual working chat, not the regression adapter.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Inspected the actual saved-register JSON for both phases: revised appointment, persisted meeting/actions, current context and explicit calendar_refresh_required/scheduler_installed flags. These are actual local service outputs. The teacher must open/explain real outputs and produce the ordinary model-data report through the workflow; this regression does not attest such a host delivery. A real calendar extension requires a selected account and specific event authorization.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The independent actual practice saves Incontro con Luca at 2026-11-12T15:00:00+01:00 for Elena. Its follow-up is done and recoverable. Tests re-read unchanged demo and ordinary registers. The learner must formulate the request and explain register versus current calendar versus scheduled briefing; the materials and synthetic test do not manufacture learner responses.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read all it text and both localized input titles, requests, busy-period label and meeting notes. Six planned stages total 390 seconds; execution and questions add time. Dates include an explicit timezone offset. No human timing, comprehension or installed-host voice acceptance has been measured.
